subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should ClawHub adopt this durable profile/discovery terminology and future-surface contract now, or limit this PR to current official-publisher copy until feed, follow, review, and scan state designs are accepted?
rationale: The code can mechanically render the proposed labels, but tests cannot decide whether the labels are permanent product vocabulary or whether the new spec should commit ClawHub to the listed future surfaces.

options.title: Accept narrow facts and trim future commitments
options.body: Keep the code-backed labels for existing payload facts, but narrow the spec to current invariants and defer unimplemented feed, follow, and filter commitments to their owning proposals.

options.title: Accept the full discovery contract
options.body: Approve the terminology and broader future profile, feed, follow, review, and scan surface commitments together, retaining this PR as the first implementation slice.

options.title: Defer the terminology slice
options.body: Pause this PR until the related publisher-facts and feed or follow APIs establish the complete vocabulary and backing data model.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow facts and trim future commitments
recommendation.body: Keep the code-backed labels for existing payload facts, but narrow the spec to current invariants and defer unimplemented feed, follow, and filter commitments to their owning proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: Related merged publisher-profile refresh work provides the strongest available ownership signal for deciding how this profile UI should evolve.
